title: MARS: Efficient, Adaptive Co-Scheduling for Heterogeneous Agentic Systems
authors: Yifei Wang; Hancheng Ye; Yechen Xu; Cong Guo; Chiyue Wei; Qinsi Wang; Dongting Li; Tingjun Chen; Hai "Helen" Li; Danyang Zhuo; Yiran Chen
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Agentic workloads induce a temporal shift (single-turn to multi-turn LLM+tool loops) and a spatial shift (chat-scale to repository-scale, GPU-only to GPU+CPU co-located execution). Existing throughput-centric, request-oblivious serving engines cannot coordinate the heterogeneous, coupled GPU+CPU resource demands of multi-turn agent sessions, leading to KV-cache thrash, head-of-line blocking on long prefills, and GPU-CPU coupled queueing.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic workload 帶來時間軸位移（單輪推論轉為多輪 LLM 與工具循環）與空間軸位移（chat 規模轉為 repository 規模、GPU-only 轉為 GPU 與 CPU 共置執行）。現有以 throughput 為中心、忽略 request 屬性的 serving engine 無法協調多輪 agent session 對 GPU 與 CPU 的耦合需求，導致 KV cache 反覆抖動、長 prefill 造成 head-of-line 阻塞，以及 GPU 與 CPU 間的耦合排隊。

key_innovation.en: MARS introduces session-aware co-scheduling around three components: (i) a Unified Information Stream that exports GPU memory pressure (gpu_submit/1st_token/end events) and CPU tool-execution pressure as low-overhead telemetry; (ii) an External Control Plane that adaptively sizes the admission window W_adm via AIMD over dual-pressure signals; (iii) an Internal Agent-Centric Scheduler combining a Priority-Aware Coordinator (Multi-Level Feedback Queue keyed on initial footprint + accumulated service + waiting time) with an Opportunistic Co-Scheduler that incrementally fits requests by chunk-shrinking instead of evicting.
key_innovation.zh: MARS 提出 session-aware 的協同排程，包含三個組件：(i) Unified Information Stream，將 GPU 記憶體壓力（gpu_submit/1st_token/end 事件）與 CPU 工具執行壓力以低成本 telemetry 形式匯出；(ii) External Control Plane，依雙壓力訊號透過 AIMD 動態調整 admission window W_adm；(iii) Internal Agent-Centric Scheduler，由 Priority-Aware Coordinator（以初始 footprint、累計服務、等待時間為鍵的 Multi-Level Feedback Queue）與 Opportunistic Co-Scheduler（以 chunk-shrink 替代 eviction 漸進塞入 request）組成。

key_improvements.en: Up to 5.94x lower mean end-to-end latency and up to 1.34x lower P95 latency over the strongest baseline across 28 operating points on H100/H200. In OpenHands real deployment on H200, task completion time improves by up to 1.87x.
key_improvements.zh: 在 H100 與 H200 上涵蓋 28 個操作點時，相較最強 baseline 平均 end-to-end 延遲最高降低 5.94x、P95 延遲最高降低 1.34x。在 H200 上以 OpenHands 實際部署時，任務完成時間最高提升 1.87x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100 NVL (96 GB), NVIDIA H200 NVL (144 GB), AMD EPYC 9355, DRAM
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; uses telemetry-driven AIMD rather than predictive accuracy metric)
validation_workloads: SWE-bench, GitTaskBench, Terminal-Bench, RepoBench, InfBench (mixed into four input-length regimes ILR-1 to ILR-4)

scope_assumptions.en: Built on vLLM V1 with backend serving and batching layers unchanged (only V1 scheduling layer extended). Targets single-node deployments with co-located tool execution and CPU pinning isolating engine from tools. Dynamic SLO-Aware Goodput defines per-request SLO target as alpha x T_ideal with alpha measured at concurrency=1; alpha=3 used in the headline plot. Goodput evaluation requires per-request slack factor and treats tool execution as host-CPU-bound.
scope_assumptions.zh: 建構於 vLLM V1，僅延伸 V1 排程層，backend serving 與 batching 層維持不變。針對單節點部署，工具與 LLM 共置且以 CPU pinning 隔離。Dynamic SLO-Aware Goodput 將每筆 request 的 SLO 目標設為 alpha x T_ideal，T_ideal 在 concurrency=1 量得，主結果圖採用 alpha=3。Goodput 評估需 per-request slack factor，且假設工具執行為 host-CPU bound。
